revenue.source: Revenues from sales (net of excise taxes), TotalEnergies Q4/FY2025 results press release (10 Feb 2026) and stockanalysis.com for FY2023; USD m

operating_income.source: stockanalysis.com TTE financials (data-provider operating income; IFRS has no operating income line, so reviewer should verify definition vs. the 20-F, accession 0001104659-26-035876)

d_and_a.source: Consolidated cash flow statement 'Depreciation, depletion, amortization and impairment', Q4/FY2025 press release (FY2025, FY2024). FY2023 full-year figure not found (search limit reached); includes impairments

capex.source: 'Intangible assets and PP&E additions' from cash flow statement; FY2025 = sum of quarters 4,222+4,766+3,812+4,153, FY2024 = 3,420+3,699+4,110+3,680 (quarterly TotalEnergies results releases). FY2023 not found. Excludes acquisitions

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 revenue fell 6.8% on lower oil prices; upstream production grew 3.9% in 2025 (press release). Modest 3% rebound then ~2% (inflation-like) as energy-price normalization and growth in LNG/power offset price pressure.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: between FY2025 (10.8%) and FY2024 (12.6%) EBIT margins from history above; mid-cycle with oil price below FY2023-24 levels.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: TotalEnergies' effective tax rate is high (~40%) due to upstream taxation in high-tax jurisdictions; not verified against filing – reviewer to check.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 16,953/182,344 = 9.3%, FY2024 7.6%; use 9.0% in line with company's ~$16-17bn capex guidance level (unverified) while growth continues

wacc.source: Assumption: large-cap integrated oil major, beta ~0.8-0.9, risk-free ~4%, ERP ~5%, low leverage; ~8.5%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run inflation given energy-transition risk to hydrocarbon demand

net_debt.source: TotalEnergies 20-F FY2025 (accession 0001104659-26-035876), company-defined net debt at 31 Dec 2025 (excludes leases; net of cash 26,202 and current/non-current financial assets)

diluted_shares.source: Fully-diluted weighted-average shares FY2025 = 2,214 million, Q4/FY2025 press release (year-end diluted count was 2,167m)
